operator_instruction.text: GO: rerun MF short_direct under the standard (c2p0) recipe; queue it and let it take the GPU when the running ablation finishes
operator_instruction.role_note: gpu-p1-host.service is disabled/inactive, so p1/pending is never seated. p2 host is the only live seater and already gates on a GPU probe, which gives the requested hand-off behaviour.

hypothesis.question: Is A3's MusicCaps deficit against c2p0 slot0 an artifact of recipe drift rather than of the Music Flamingo corpus?

recipe_drift_found.lr_schedule: A3 inherited lr_schedule=step, so runner_flowmatching.py:214 set [0.8N,0.9N] gamma 0.1 and LR fell to 1e-6 over the last 20% of each stage; every c2p0 arm pinned [999999,999999] and held 1e-4.
recipe_drift_found.budget: A3 ran S1 200k / S2 100k (1.60M samples); c2p0 full runs S1 400k / S2 200k (3.20M samples).
recipe_drift_found.gt_cache: A3 passed no gt_cache, so extracted_audio.py:49 fell back to sequential i.npz without an audit.
recipe_drift_found.matched_after_all: use_text_attention_mask was off on both sides (c2p0 sets it false explicitly; A3 predates the feature), and seed/batch/lr/rope/q/warmup already matched.

hypothesis.not_controlled: corpus rows stay 100k vs c2p0's 251,599, and the captioner stays Music Flamingo. This run isolates recipe, not corpus.
hypothesis.prior: c2p0 slot0 gains only +0.0120 CLAP across a 4x compute increase (quarter 0.2029 -> full 0.2149 at CFG0), so recipe/budget is not expected to close the -0.083 gap. The run is justified because the existing comparison is not recipe-matched, independent of that expectation.

decision_rule.comparator: c2p0 slot0 full = 0.2605 CLAP under MusicCaps 5521 / MF25 / CFG 3.0 / fidelity negative / NoMask / seed 42 / full precision / --no_q
decision_rule.gte_0_24: recipe drift was the dominant cause; Music Flamingo is viable, proceed to caption the remaining 151k clips and rerun at 251k
decision_rule.0_20_to_0_24: recipe explains part of the gap; corpus scale becomes the open question
decision_rule.lte_0_20: recipe was not the cause; the Music Flamingo line is closed under this protocol

sources.npz_note: The May 2026 NPZ cache was deleted during disk cleanup; only the manifest TSV survived, so the action re-extracts audio latents and text features before training.

pairing_audit.runtime_guard: The action writes the cache list explicitly and then re-encodes 20 sampled captions with FeaturesUtils(t5_clap), requiring cosine >= 0.999 against the stored text_features_c. Extraction itself defines row order (extract_audio_latents.py:240,246), so the explicit list documents the binding rather than changing it.

primary_cell.negative_prompt: low quality recording, noisy, amateur, distorted, muffled, poor fidelity, hiss, lo-fi
primary_cell.why: matches the arm-comparison table this run is meant to join; NOT comparable to the canonical CFG0 table

canonical_cell.why: required by harn_guest.py completion evidence, and puts the arm on the canonical CFG0 table beside slot0 full 0.2149

bindings.indirection_note: accept_guest hashes commands.run[-1], so the scale cannot ride as a trailing argument. The per-scale entry point is hashed here and re-verifies shared_action_sha256 at runtime before exec, so both files are effectively pinned.

launch_authorization.scope: NPZ re-extraction, full-scale training, one CFG 3.0 comparison eval and one canonical CFG 0 eval
launch_authorization.queue_position: tail of p2/pending; does not preempt
